scope: Iowa Great Lakes bookable fishing guides in the Dickinson County chain
recommended_first_source: The 2026 Iowa Code chapter 483A section index (https://www.legis.iowa.gov/law/iowaCode/sections?codeChapter=483A) is the fishing-and-hunting license chapter. No section title on that index is a fishing-guide, charter, or outfitter license. Section 483A.22A is the department's authority to charge for lists of licensees. It is not a roster.
highest_priority_permission_question: Section 483A.22A says the department may set a fee for lists of licensees that may exceed the cost of copying, notwithstanding section 22.3. No fishing-guide roster was found. Do section 22.3 or a rule under 483A.22A authorize buying a licensee list and copying names into a commercial directory? The policies page does not grant that use. Both Iowa Great Lakes directories reserve all rights.
